# Acorn Juice Solutions

> Independent software studio from Navarra, Spain. We build focused, well-crafted software for people and teams — from utilities and widgets to mobile apps, websites, APIs, pipelines and cloud infrastructure. The site is bilingual (English and Spanish); every English URL below has a Spanish counterpart under `/es/`, listed in the Spanish section.

## Products

- [AccuVideo](https://acornjuice.com/products/accuvideo/): Semantic search over your video library. Ask in plain language, jump to the exact second. 100% local, Windows and macOS.
- [SOSNav](https://acornjuice.com/products/sosnav/): Free mobile utility that shows on-call pharmacies and emergency service locations in Navarra, Spain. iOS and Android.
- [Sweet Enough](https://acornjuice.com/products/sweet-enough/): Minimal home-screen widget for iOS and Android that shows your current blood glucose reading at a glance.
- [GitHub Download Counter](https://acornjuice.com/products/github-counter/): Android home-screen widget that shows the total download count of any public GitHub repository's releases.
- [All products (index)](https://acornjuice.com/products/): Full product catalogue.
